text: Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that helps computers learn from data. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. From this data, the computer builds a model that can make predictions about new information. For example, a model can learn to recognise spam emails by studying many emails that are already marked as spam or not spam. After training, we test the model to see how accurate its predictions are. Accuracy shows how often the model is correct. The better the training data, the more accurate the predictions will be.
